workarounds.symptom: fix(agents): define subprocess text encoding for CLI agents and command graders
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agents): exchange subprocess text as UTF-8. Target files: agentdescent/_subprocess.py, agentdescent/agents.py, agentdescent/rewards.py. Agent, grader and shared runner pipes now exchange UTF-8 bytes and decode explicitly on the calling thread.
